name: Maroon Grace
source:
Main character is adopted by Kurihara family at a young age after parents loss. He lives happily with a new uncle and two sisters-in-law. But he starts to get worried about his future. Should he leave this family already? Or should he stay? And if he stays - should he seek love with one of the sisters?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
